mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a 20-day return predictor falls below 0.05 in any 3-year rolling window or average 20-day return during declining FEDFUNDS is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate exceeds 8.0% for two consecutive months, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in >40% of instances when UNRATE >8.0% for two months, or average 5-day return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in residential construction permits (HOUST) and consumer credit (RSAFS) indicates housing market weakness and reduced consumer spending, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Interaction term (HOUST * RSAFS) fails to predict 60-day returns with Rank IC >0.04 in any 3-year window or negative return pattern absent when both series decline.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 100 (2017=100), it signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in >50% of INDPRO <100 periods or average return not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising residential construction permits (HOUST) consistently indicate housing market strength that boosts consumer confidence and corporate revenues, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for HOUST as 5-day return predictor falls below 0.03 in any 2-year window or average 5-day return during rising HOUST not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that triggers monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in >50% of CPIAUCSL YoY >3.0% periods or average return not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicates labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Interaction term (PAYEMS * UNRATE) fails to predict 20-day returns with Rank IC >0.04 in any 3-year window or negative return pattern absent when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises.

mechanism_narrative: When consumer credit growth exceeds 400,000 million dollars (RSAFS > 400000), it signals robust consumer spending that supports corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in >40% of RSAFS >400000 periods or average return not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).
